the levels of mycotoxicines in feed are dependent on the raw material used and on the geographical location where they were grown.

The main takeaway from our work is that
mycotoxin exposure in pig and poultry feed can be minimized by using raw materials with the lowest possible mycotoxin concentrations and by avoiding the use of contaminated raw materials.
the levels of mycotoxicosis in pigs and poultry depend not only on the type of raw materials used in the diet but also on the stage of production.
